t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They scored higher if they selected right for 5x and left for 1x. They said the best scores are a combinatino of modifier, colour and hat height. Also said not to miss any by forgetting to press s, k or space

vb_textbox.text: I started by trying to choose any pink colours like pink, purple, blue. As the game went on I found that yellow tones seemed to score higher so I would go for the yellow tones. Main piece of advice is to work quickly, a couple of times I took too long and then missed out on that round.
